title: 3D Block Jigsaw
description: Fit colorful 3D polyomino blocks snugly into sculpted geometric trays with zero gaps—rotate your thinking and lock every satisfying click into place.
controls: Drag 3D polyomino blocks from the dock into the puzzle frame so all pieces fill the tray completely with no overlaps.

zh-CN.title: 3D 方块拼图
zh-CN.description: 极度舒适的 3D 立体七巧板拼块：把糖果色异形立体方块严丝合缝塞进几何托盘，强迫症看了直呼解压。
zh-CN.controls: 拖动下方彩色 3D 方块放入棋盘空格，将全部区域严丝合缝填满即可过关。
